title: A Ruler for Every Prime
subject: https://github.com/the-omega-institute/trureturing
style: trureturing cyberpunk · log-scale ruler bars for the flat and prime readings, the six norm-5 spinors as tiles, 2 × 2 residue matrices and their 6 × 6 product table, a chain of rank-one links, the radial Cayley tree of reduced words, six 45° caps on a sphere
summary: Every prime gets its own ruler. The flat ruler |n|∞ stretches as we count 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, while ruler p reads p^(−v): on log-scale bars the magenta prime readings exactly balance the cyan flat reading, and the products for 2 … 6 and the escape witness 31 (blind to rulers 2, 3, 5) are recomputed as 1. Lean checks the rational adelic product formula and the rational linear independence of prime logarithms. Reading primes as curvature-recovery nuclei is the book's interpretation (argued). In the whole quaternions 5 = (1 + 2i)(1 − 2i) splits into six spinors S₅; Lean checks that each has squared norm 5 and fidelity 1/5, and the 3-4-5 rotation 5R(1 + 2i) is recomputed by conjugation. Mod 5, where 2² ≡ −1, the six spinors become 2 × 2 residue matrices; their rank-one factors and the 6 × 6 product table, zero exactly on a spinor followed by its inverse, are recomputed, and Lean checks the rank-one splitting and the zero-product law. The reduced word (1 + 2i)(1 + 2j)(1 + 2k) = (−7, 6, −2, 6) has squared norm 125 = 5³, link scalars 3 and 4 and residues 3, 1, 3, 1 (computed; the chain of nonzero links is the proof idea, argued); Lean checks that every word has squared norm 5^L and every reduced word stays nonzero mod 5, and that reduced words moving the x and y axes alike are equal, so S₅ freely generates F₃ inside SO(3, ℚ). The counts 6, 30, 150, the 187 distinct rotations up to length 3 and the bit height ½ log₂ 5 ≈ 1.160964 are computed. Last, six norm-5 axes in ℝ³ with their 45° caps: Lean checks the six sets are open, cover the sphere and contain no orthogonal pair; the sampled points are only a picture.
summary_zh: 每个素数一把尺。数 2、3、4、5、6 时平直尺 |n|∞ 越拉越长，第 p 把尺读 p^(−v)：对数刻度的条形图上，品红的素数读数与青色的平直读数恰好等长，2 至 6 与对 2、3、5 号尺全盲的逃逸见证 31 的总积均重算为 1。Lean 检验有理阿代尔乘积归元公式与素数对数的有理线性无关性；把素数读作曲率回收核是本书诠释（论证）。在整四元数中 5 = (1 + 2i)(1 − 2i) 分裂出六枚素旋子 S₅：Lean 检验每一枚模方为 5、保真度为 1/5，1 + 2i 的 (3, 4, 5) 旋转 5R 由共轭重算。模 5（2² ≡ −1）下六枚素旋子变成 2×2 余数矩阵，其秩一分解与 6×6 乘积表（恰在一枚素旋子紧接其逆处为零）为屏幕重算，Lean 检验秩一分裂与零积判据。既约词 (1 + 2i)(1 + 2j)(1 + 2k) = (−7, 6, −2, 6) 的模方 125 = 5³、衔接标量 3 与 4、模 5 余数 3、1、3、1 为屏幕计算（衔接处非零的链式图景是证明思路，属论证）；Lean 检验任意词模方为 5^L、任意既约词模 5 不为零，以及把 x、y 两轴转到同一处的既约词相同，故 S₅ 在 SO(3, ℚ) 中自由生成 F₃。词数 6、30、150，长度不超过 3 的 187 个互异旋转与比特高度 ½ log₂ 5 ≈ 1.160964 为屏幕计算。最后是 ℝ³ 中六根模方 5 的轴及其 45° 球冠：Lean 检验六片都是开集、盖满球面且不含正交对；球面采样点只是示意。
